title: I started a “dirt notebook”
summary: A personal blog post where the author shares their experience of starting a 'dirt notebook' - an unfiltered, low-pressure journaling practice for capturing raw daily observations without worrying about polish or quality.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of overcoming perfectionism and overthinking when writing or documenting daily life.
why_valuable: Provides a simple, accessible approach to consistent personal journaling that removes the pressure of producing polished content.
